confidence_notes: Medium-low detail confidence. Restaurant and drink anchors rest on one crowdsourced, undated site (MyLifeElsewhere) and one undated Citycost figure, so the mid-range two-person meal is a blended estimate across a wide spread (about $9 to $18). Accommodation sources disagree widely (1-star roughly $17 to $48; 3-star roughly $15 to $107 by season), so I anchored to typical mid-year averages, and July is a domestic school-holiday peak. Cocktail and wine glass have no direct source; they are set from beer using the local price relationship (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 3x beer because of import duties). FX 0.6955 for 15 Oct 2026 comes from an RBA page that appeared in search results; I did not open the page separately. A third-party 16 Oct figure (0.6947) was not used because it is unverified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Anchors are triangulated from Yogyakarta-specific aggregator data (MyLifeElsewhere, Citycost, Budget Your Trip, Champion Traveler, Momondo, KAYAK, Trip.com, Hostelz), converted at roughly IDR 17,900 per USD implied by those sources. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor, as described in confidence_notes.
